evidence: Plin. Ep. 7.9.15: ajunt enim multum legendum esse, nōn multa
terms.gloss: one should read much, not many things

terms.comment: The modern tag, made from Pliny’s words. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
